top: This man found a cat barely moving in a puddle in the snow, so he carried it inside
comment: A warm towel and a spot by the wood stove later, it was meowing and curled up in his lap. His words: “They really do have nine lives.”
topic_it: Todd Oland trova un gatto quasi immobile in una pozza nella neve, lo scalda vicino alla stufa a legna e il gatto si riprende (video virale, 25 nov)
photo_it: Fotogrammi del video di Todd Oland (YouTube @toddoland7021, via TAG24)
title: He was fighting for his life in the snow #rescue #emotional #cat
description:
A man found a cat barely moving in a puddle in the snow and warmed it by the wood stove until it was meowing in his lap. Video by Todd Oland.
